explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 23 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the carboplatin shortage on 2023-04-28 and it has remained current for 42 months as of 2026-10-21.
The Accord Healthcare product on the shortage list uses Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited as a registered manufacturing plant.
FDA inspection 1191818 at Intas ended 2022-12-02 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2023-04-05 — 23 days before the shortage posting.
An import alert 66-40 for Intas was published 2023-06-01 (34 days after posting) and again 2023-11-14 (200 days after posting), and a Warning Letter was issued 2023-07-28 (91 days after posting).
Our Corvale East site holds two NDCs: Teva (0703-4239-01) manufactured by PHARMACHEMIE BV and Apotex (60505-6282-1) manufactured by Teyro Labs Private Limited.
Teyro Labs received a VAI classification on 2025-11-12, while PHARMACHEMIE BV has no FDA action shown in the evidence.
The rule‑ranked transfer option moves 26 units from Corvale East (18 days on hand) to Corvale Lakeside (1.9 days on hand), bringing Lakeside to 14 days.

memory.text: Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: move the primary carboplatin contract from Accord to Teva and keep Accord as secondary. Rationale: Accord's supplier plant had an FDA warning letter; Teva supply steadier (demo history). Approved by Riley Brooks, PharmD.

Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-83799e.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%carboplatin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%carboplatin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-75e19f.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('f330f5a2-2cad-402f-bcbb-26245a753276', '1c275825-0275-4c73-b650-e4c1519f13b8', '48aa7ef3-9f44-2a08-e054-00144ff88e88') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-0ae550.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%carboplatin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-fac1d7.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%carboplatin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-697c1e.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%carboplatin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-b55bd0.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3021389808', '3004011473', '3009056604', '3011960448', '1450022', '3001174929') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-403c2f.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3021389808', '3004011473') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('teyro', 'intas', 'pharmachemie')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-cf1615.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('teyro', 'intas', 'pharmachemie', 'teva parenteral medicines', 'apotex', 'accord') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%carboplatin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-c730e9.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('1191818') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-bbee4f.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00703423901', '60505628201', '16729029512')
